top_signals.title: The Golden Dome Proposal is Destabilizing and Dangerous
top_signals.summary:

Please also read the first, “Golden Dome Is Technologically and Financially Infeasible.”Golden Dome is an ambitious proposal for a comprehensive, layered defense, with ground, sea, and space-based elements. It is supposed to protect the United States, its allies, and deployed forces from attacks by ballistic missiles, cruise missiles, hypersonic boost-glide vehicles, aircraft, and drones launched by any adversary, including peer adversaries. top_signals.title: Iran Braces for Trump's Next Move After Democrats Sweep Congress
top_signals.summary: The landslide victory by Democrats in US midterm elections is expected to bring change to Congress and foreign policy in Washington. But inside Iran, many officials said they expect the country will remain in the crosshairs of President Donald Trump, even if the vote has left him weaker. As the results poured in late on November 3, showing Democrats had taken control of both the House of Representatives and Senate from their Republican rivals, Trump admitted the war he launched on Iran on the last day of February had taken a toll on his party.…

top_signals.title: SOCAR Bets $1.65 Billion on U.S. Shale Gas Boom
top_signals.summary: Azerbaijan’s state oil and gas company SOCAR has struck a deal with Comstock to acquire some of its assets in the Haynesville shale and an infrastructure subsidiary. The price tag of the deal is $1.65 billion. The purchase includes a 20% stake in Comstock’s legacy Haynesville assets, a 15% stake in Western Haynesville, and 15% of Comstock’s majority interest in gas infrastructure subsidiary Pinnacle Gas Services. The deal comes amid widely shared expectations of extended growth in global demand for natural gas and U.S. growth…

top_signals.title: Chip Stocks Sink as Traders Rotate Into ‘Old Economy’ Stocks
top_signals.summary: US equities plunged Thursday as a rotation out of chipmakers deepened and investors looked past the initial relief rally following the US midterm elections.

top_signals.title: Nasdaq 100 Falls 3.5% as Chipmaker Selloff Deepens: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: The rout in chipmakers gathered pace, with investors weighing any potential impacts of a Democratic sweep of Congress on the artificial-intelligence trade that has powered the bull market in stocks.

top_signals.title: RBC Hires Gaut From Mizuho to Head Strategic Equity Dealmaking
top_signals.summary: Royal Bank of Canada has hired equity capital markets banker Mariano Gaut from Mizuho Financial Group Inc. to lead the structuring of corporate derivatives and origination of convertible bond deals globally.

top_signals.summary: Democrats are preparing to put a spotlight back on Epstein as part of sweeping investigations following their wipeout victories in Tuesday's midterm elections.
